extracted.name: Horseradish Cream Sauce
extracted.description: Whipped cream, mayonnaise, and horseradish create a creamy condiment perfect for a wide variety of meats.
ingredient_lines: 0.75 cup heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks
1 pinch white sugar, or to taste
salt and black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Stir the mayonnaise, horseradish, and Dijon mustard in a bowl until evenly combined. Fold in the whipped cream, then season to taste with sugar, salt, and pepper.
